how: results/structural_audit_samples.txt holds up to 5 distinct correct programs labelled with the unit's default and 5 labelled with r_u (random, seed 7); the executor read the samples listed below in full

B1.default arithmetic_sum: 5/5 closed formula or sum(range) minus sum
B1.r_u xor_fold: 3/3 distinct (only 3 exist): XOR over 0..n and values

B3.default kruskal: sorted roads + union-find (many twin programs also build an unused adjacency list and import heapq)
B3.r_u prim_heap: 5/5 lazy Prim: heap of frontier (weight, city), visited array -- heap Prim, not array Prim

B4.r_u float_sqrt: 4/5 int(math.sqrt(x)) or int(x ** 0.5); 1/5 hybrid: right = int(x ** 0.5) as the upper bound of a binary search, labelled float_sqrt by the rule precedence (float before binary search) -- noted, not changed after the freeze

B5.r_u iterative_doubling: base programs: cascading (res + [s + [x]]) and recursive cascading (solve(rest) then prepend first), counted as iterative_doubling per the plan

B7.r_u sorted_insertion_bisect: 5/5 bisect_left + insort over a reversed scan -- insort, not Fenwick

summary: no label/mechanism mismatch in 36 programs read; one hybrid (B4) documented
